name: Trailside Summer Camp
operator_name: Union County Parks and Recreation, Trailside Nature and Science Center
description_short: Union County's nature programs at Trailside in the Watchung Reservation for ages 6 to 12, grouped 6 to 7, 8 to 9 and 10 to 12. Children take a morning session, an afternoon session or both, with themed weeks on animals, insects, streams, birds and Lenape life.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds from March 9 to June 12 less a $35 nonrefundable fee per half day session; no refunds after June 12 and no credits.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp 2026 for ages 6 to 12 in the Watchung Reservation, morning, afternoon or full day. Registration opened March 7 for Union County residents and March 9 for out of county residents. The only date in the page text is 'Three Day Program, June 30th to July 2nd'; the program chart with dates, times and fees is not in the page text.

source.title: Camps & Workshops – County of Union, New Jersey
